description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the Attributes interface, providing methods for creating, manipulating, and accessing attribute data represented as JSON objects. It includes static factory methods, data type checks, getters, setters, and serialization logic, encapsulating JSON-based attribute handling within an immutable class.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributes
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe implementation of the Attributes interface that wraps a JSON object to provide attribute access and modification functions.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty instance of Attributes.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new Attributes instance initialized with data from a provided JSON object, validating JSON keys.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a long integer.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a JSON object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is a JSON array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the underlying JSON value is null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as an int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonObject.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the JSON value as a JsonArray.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the Attributes by key for various primitive types and JsonValue.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a JSON field or field definition with a value.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JSON fields from an iterable collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the Attributes by key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a nested JsonObject at a specified JsonPointer or JsonField.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field as an Optional.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a field or throws if absent.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of all keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns a JsonField for a given key, if it exists.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no attributes.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the underlying JSON object, optionally filtered by schema version and predicate.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the object into the provided SerializationContext.
